verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an AI Editor that lets users create and modify ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts. That is a real first-party natural-language interface, but it covers only one narrow feature area rather than general operation of the product. The other AI features (evidence gap analysis, AI-assisted due diligence) and the compliance-skills repo for coding agents are not natural-language control of Sprinto itself, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: natural-language control beyond ingestion workflows (controls, risks, policies, audits, tasks), a conversational assistant or chat interface for the platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI Editor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
